title: Stylist: haircuts (style and colour) and hair dyes
player_outcome: The Stylist's 'Haircut' opens a preview of your character. Pick a hairstyle and colour, see it live, and pay. Her shop sells Terraria hair dyes, including Life, Mana, Depth, Time and Money dyes that change colour as you play.
design: Core: a new 'haircut' service {price, colorPrice} and a TownServices.Stylist.cs partial with Haircut(npc, player, string style, string colorHex) → TradeResult. It validates the style against Appearance.StylesFor(body) and the hex colour, charges happiness-scaled coins, sets Look.HairStyle/HairColor, and raises PlayerState.LookChanged (a new event).

Hair dyes: a new item behavior 'hairDye' {mode: static|life|mana|depth|time|money|speed|biome|rainbow, color} that sets Look.HairDye (string, serialised in PlayerSave.Look automatically). A static helper HairDyes.ColorFor(PlayerEntity, WorldSession) in Core/Gameplay/Player computes the dynamic colour as a pure function of vitals, depth, clock, coins and speed.

Game: a new PlayerAvatar.Look.cs partial. On LookChanged, rebuild the avatar CreatureVisual: preload the new model with ResourceLoader.LoadThreadedRequest and swap on completion, so the swap causes no spike. Every 0.5 s with a dynamic dye, call _visual.SetAppearance with the dyed hair colour.

HaircutPanel (game/UI/HaircutPanel.cs): a CharacterPreview (reused from game/Menu) showing a copy of the look, style buttons, the colour swatch palette used by the character-creation screen (MainMenu.Characters), a price label, and Buy/Cancel. TownDialog.Services registers 'haircut'.
Stylist shop: hair dyes (life/mana/depth/money/time/team?/speed/biome; rainbow/martian/twilight in hardmode, verify) and hair_dye_remover. Assets via the potion generator; reference concepts.
data_changes: about 10 hair dye items; stylist services [haircut] and shop
tests: StylistTests.HaircutChangesLookAndCharges; an invalid style is refused and not charged; TooPoor
HairDyeTests: life dye at full vs 10% life gives different colours; the depth dye changes with depth
Smoke town.cmds: 'town summon stylist 1 0 -3' / 'ui talk stylist' / 'ui service haircut' / 'ui close' / 'assert errors == 0'
verification: dotnet test; in game the haircut preview shows the new style and the avatar swaps without a frame hitch (F3 frame graph)
risks: PlayerAvatar is also modified by the facing phase (body always faces the crosshair); keep the look swap in its own partial.
Only the generated hairstyles exist (5 male, 4 female); more styles belong to the art pipeline.
